perQuery.description: Selective filter on (site_id, timestamp) - the pattern both schemas index.

perQuery.title: Multi-dimensional GROUP BY
perQuery.description: Four grouping columns at once - wide aggregation across many columns.

perQuery.title: Dashboard-style KPI (single site, 30 days)

perQuery.title: UTM campaign breakdown (30 days)
perQuery.description: Filtered multi-column GROUP BY - acquisition-report shape.

perQuery.title: Hourly traffic pattern
